variants.name: Вариант 1 — чистое стекло
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: refined transparent logo proposal for Holy Mayhem.
Input image: the provided PNG is the edit target and the exact geometric reference.
Primary request: simplify this specific glass cross slightly so it works as a premium website logo at small sizes. Preserve its exact underlying 3D shape and proportions: the rectangular cross section, straight perpendicular arms, short upper stem, much longer lower stem, and the original ratio of arm width to stem thickness. Do not redesign the silhouette, turn it upside down, change the arm placement, flare or taper the ends, or add holes.
Simplify the material detailing: replace the many nested outlines, micro-facets and multicolored shards with ONE clean shallow bevel, broad continuous dark smoky-glass faces and a few controlled specular highlights. Retain the glass character, restrained blue/cyan or lavender edge refraction, and crisp corners. Reduce rainbow dispersion dramatically. No chrome metal, jewelry, ornament, etched detail, inner frame, glow, particles or motion trails.
Composition: one complete isolated cross, centered, comfortably filling a square canvas with an even transparent margin of at least 8 percent; all ends fully visible. No text, no additional symbols, no floor, no cast shadow, no background. Genuine transparent alpha outside the object. The dark glass faces should remain smoky and legible on a nearly black website, not become completely invisible.
Variant direction: closest to the reference. Keep essentially the same gentle three-quarter perspective and clockwise in-plane lean. Turn the broad front face just slightly more toward the viewer, without significant foreshortening. Use a restrained softbox reflection, a fine cool-white edge highlight, and only tiny cyan accents. About sixty percent less edge detail than the reference. Calm, clean, precise and logo-friendly.
